content:
The image shows a mango leaf with irregular brown lesions on the upper surface. The spots are:
- Irregular/oval shaped, brownish, on the leaf surface
- Some appear sunken or depressed
- Located on a young-looking leaf
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No black sooty encrustation covering the surface (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No gum secretion or bark darkening (rules out Die Back — also this is a leaf, not a twig/branch)

The lesions match Anthracnose: irregular brown spots on the leaf surface, somewhat sunken appearance, on what appears to be a young mango leaf. The pattern is consistent with the described "irregular, oval-shaped spots all over the leaf surface."
